title: Vertical — Six-window machine · Disco D
description: Six independent reels share one vertical cabinet in two columns and three rows. Each stops on a different team color; the final stop at ten seconds triggers the six-color celebration. All 108 approved portraits appear across the reels. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.

title: Vertical — One reel builds six · Disco D
description: One large reel selects each team’s portrait, which shrinks into a growing collection below. The final portrait joins the others as the six-person grid expands into place on the ten-second music hit. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.

title: Vertical — Two reels, three rounds · Disco D
description: Two large reels are stacked vertically. Three rounds feature Yellow and Red, Green and Pink, then Blue and Purple. They become one six-person grid on the ten-second music hit. All three use the same six winners and identical Disco D music, with five seconds of celebration. Full square portraits, no text, ready for vertical social posts.
